# August Health

August Health is a Software Development company. August Health EHR provides modern, fully-digital move-in experiences for seniors and communities, including reactive tactics, proactive care strategies, medication management, analytics, billing & payments, and care track. August Health employs 116 people (+48.7% YoY, +38 people), founded in 2020. Headquartered in San Francisco, California, United States.

## About

Our mission is to empower the essential work of caring for all our elders. 

August Health is the easy-to-use EHR platform that caregivers love, known for improving care quality, simplifying compliance, and enabling better care tracking and analytics. Designed with senior living experts and built by world-class engineers, the software platform makes it easier for communities to provide the best care. With the addition of August Intelligence, the platform will offer AI-powered insights that help communities act faster and more confidently. Since launching in 2020, August Health has been adopted by leading operators across the country, including Sonida Senior Living, 12 Oaks Senior Living, Bickford Senior Living, Koelsch Communities, and Westmont Living. Learn more at augusthealth.com
